definition.workflowName: CLI Consistency Checker - source-native documentation facet

intent.goal: Make CLI commands consistent, well documented and free of user-facing defects.
intent.acceptance: A source-defined literal documentation obligation is attained exactly when its Contains/NotContains predicate, with the original source scope, holds on the immutable CLI documentation bytes.

evidence.opportunity: Every literal string Contains/NotContains assertion over text, compileSection or updateSection in these source-native tests.
filters: Engine-registry-dependent assertion remains inventoried and unavailable; not silently classified as clean.
compileSection and updateSection intentionally retain the original tests' suffix-of-document semantics, not a narrowed heading section.
Current frozen profile only. Historical profiles are not retroactively interpreted as this profile.
evidence.collection: Digest-checked complete immutable documentation and native tests from the offline source archive. Reinterpret raw native bytes, never caller-supplied acceptance counts. No remote collection.

model.architecture: Deterministic source-native obligation checks; partial repository outcome, not a whole-command acceptance model.
model.recommendation: Retain native partial progress; require independent help, examples and behavioral evidence before claiming full CLI usability or contribution.

summary.nativeLabel: Literal documentation obligation attainment (%) - partial facet only

metrics.name: Native literal documentation obligation attainment
metrics.formula: 100 * passed frozen literal source-defined documentation obligations / all frozen literal source-defined documentation obligations
